title: Looks dingy; thin
text: Looks dingy; thin. I love the size and the value of this rug. But it’s so thin and drab. Both my kids asked me if it was old/used prior to us using it because it just looks dirty as it’s normal state. It has no backing. So it needs a pad underneath it if you want comfort. I plan on moving it to the garage after I find a brighter, more cheerful replacement.

product_metadata.title: Regence Home Vintage Diamond Area Rugs - 7x10 Feet - in Beige - Hand-Sewn Construction - Durable Rugs for Living Room, Bedroom, Study - Enhance Your Home Décor
features: Textured Weave: Don't settle for boring home decor. Instead, choose a rustic and homey Vintage Diamond rug. The woven patterns instantly warm up a room for a more welcoming feel. The rug will visually enhance your room's furniture and color scheme.

Cotton Rich Recycled Yarn: Made from recycled materials and rich in cotton, this is one hardworking rug. Cotton is known to have high tensile strength, and will withstand years of wear and tear. It's breathable in hot weather and warming in winter.

Wide Range Of Colors: Bold or muted, cool or warm, there's a color for everyone in our range. Choose dark rugs for living room floors, or paler rugs for bedroom floors. Whether you prefer boho decor, or a rustic style, we've got a rug that'll suit.

Hand-sewn With Pride: Constructed by skilled hands, these area rugs have been carefully hand-sewn to make them resistant to threadbare patches and shedding - so you don't need to spend extra time sweeping up. These rugs help soundproof floors too.

Soft and Comfortable: Sometimes life gets a little trying. When you're desperately in need of some 'me' time away from the kids and pets, take refuge in a Candlewick rug. They feel divine underfoot, and you can even sprawl out on them to recharge.
